messages:
ada: quick check we still need to pick a webinar topic. two ideas on the table: (A) 'Microbenchmarks that matter: build a reproducible inference benchmark' or (B) 'From prototype to 99th pct SLA: engineering checklists for serving'. which one gives better pipeline for demo + signups?

mike: leaning A. actionable takeaways + reproducible artifacts = good signups.

nina: B has stronger enterprise pull (SLA talk). but demos are harder. we need a customer speaker for cred.

owen: can we combine? short benchmark demo then a 5min ops checklist that maps to SLAs. keeps both audiences.

tara: combo sounds good but tight. what's our target length? 35-40min?

ada: target 30-35 content. prefer 30. keeps dropoff lower.

jasper: speaker availability check: I can do a 10min reproducible bench demo (scripted). ada can own the ops checklist + customer ask.

mike: if jasper does bench, i'll do the intro + SEO-friendly narrative. nina, can you try to pull a quick customer quote (1 slide) from enterprise pilot?

nina: i'll ask legal and the customer today. might be conditional on approval but i'll try.

ada: ok speaker split: mike (intro + narrative), jasper (bench demo), ada (ops checklist + wrap). nina to chase customer quote. tara to coordinate rehearsals and flow.

owen: run-of-show rough:
- 00:00-00:03 welcome + why benchmark matters (mike)
- 00:03-00:12 live bench: baseline -> caching/batching -> quantized variant (jasper)
- 00:12-00:18 ops checklist + rollout knobs (ada)
- 00:18-00:25 customer quote + short panel (nina + all)
- 00:25-00:30 audience Qs + next steps (all)

tara: rehearsals: propose two slots: Tue 11am PT or Thu 3pm PT. please mark availability.

jasper: Thu 3pm PT works for me. will also record a fallback video of the bench clip.

mike: Tue 11am ok for me too. prefer Tue so we have Thu buffer.

ada: let's lock Tue 11am PT rehearsal, Thu 3pm final run. tara pls send calendar invites.

tara: sending invites now. I'll also create a short runbook with slide order and versioned demo artifacts. link when ready.

nina: customer says maybe a short quote ok; legal needs to sign. pax check done.

jasper: demo tech notes: bench will use a repeatable script (wrk + synthetic traffic) and pre-recorded artifacts for results. live run will use small dataset. fallback video in GDrive.

mike: marketing asks: two registration blurbs: 1) technical: highlights reproducible benchmark repo and artifacts 2) business: highlights how to prioritize perf knobs for cost and SLA. jasper/ada: any preferred wording?

ada: Technical blurb draft: 'Reproducible inference benchmarks you can run today: compare batching, caching, and quantization with a published script and artifact pack.'

jasper: Business blurb draft: 'Practical checklist for moving from prototype to predictable SLAs: what to measure, what to automate, and common fallbacks.'

mike: nice. I'll A/B test headlines on registration page.

tara: runbook link: https://drive.example.com/dir/webinar-runbook (permissions: org-internal). also added rehearsal checklist.

nina: timeline recap:
- today: confirm speakers and slots (done)
- EOD tomorrow: landing page copy + CTAs (mike + ada)
- Tue 11am PT: rehearsal 1
- Thu 3pm PT: final run
- Wed (webinar): preflight 30m prior

jasper: will upload bench artifacts and fallback video to runbook by EOD tomorrow.

ada: thanks all. last minute note: keep all slides in the single shared deck to avoid mismatched branding. I'll lock the deck 24h before the webinar.

mike: noted. closing thread — ping here for any last-minute changes.
